## Questions people ask first.

Do I need to see a doctor in person?

No. A US licensed provider reviews your assessment online and prescribes only when it is medically appropriate.

What is a compounded medication?

A compounded medication is made by a licensed US compounding pharmacy for an individual patient, so the dose and form can be tailored to your prescription. Compounded medications are not FDA approved, and your provider prescribes one only when it is medically appropriate for you.

Can I be treated for more than one thing?

Yes. You can start an assessment for each treatment you are interested in, whether that is weight loss, hair care, sexual health or longevity. Your provider reviews your full health history, including anything you already take, so your treatments are considered together.
